title: Staff Engineer, AI Developer Experience (Remote, US)
description:
Who We Are
Everyday Electric (formerly Renew Home) is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.
We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort - and cleaner energy for everyone.
We are an Equal Opportunity employer striving to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels that they have a voice that is heard.
We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing.
Role Summary
At Everyday Electric, we are embracing AI-assisted development as a core part of how we work - and we are looking for a Staff Engineer to lead that effort from the inside. This role will help define how our engineers interact with AI tools and agents, shape the standards and guardrails that make adoption safe and effective, and continuously improve the inner loop of software development: the daily experience of writing, building, testing, and iterating on code.
You will be embedded directly within the application development teams, giving you firsthand exposure to their workflows and friction points. While other engineers across the organization already contribute meaningfully to DevX, you will bring dedicated ownership, drive prioritization, and serve as the primary point of accountability for making progress. You won't be starting from scratch, and you won't be working alone.
The application engineering teams are your primary customers. Success here means earning their trust, understanding their daily workflows, and shipping improvements they notice and value. We want someone who brings expertise and fresh ideas, and who also knows how to build buy-in, incorporate feedback, and make durable change through iteration.
This is a high-impact individual contributor role with meaningful technical leadership responsibility. You will act as a force multiplier across the engineering organization by mentoring engineers, incorporating feedback, influencing engineering culture, and helping shape how we work.
What You Will Do

• Lead the evolution of our AI Developer Experience, enabling engineers to safely and effectively leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Drive the evaluation, adoption and governance of AI development tooling (code generation, in-editor assistance, agentic workflows), ensuring that adoption is practical, secure and measurable.

• Measure and improve the speed of common developer actions across our TypeScript/Node and Python codebases. This includes build times, pre-push hooks, linting, type checking, conformance checks, and Nx task orchestration.

• Own our devcontainer strategy, both local and cloud-based, to ensure a secure, consistent and reproducible development experience that scales across multiple concurrent projects.

• Maintain and improve local testing frameworks and developer-facing test infrastructure.

• Own and evolve shared internal libraries and configuration systems used across application teams, ensuring they are well-documented, versioned, and easy to adopt.

• Contribute to related areas including CI/CD and delivery pipelines, SDLC definition, language and library upgrade cycles (Node/Python, NPM, PyPI), developer onboarding and documentation, and observability.

Requirements

• 7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on developer tooling, platform engineering, or developer productivity.

• Deep familiarity with TypeScript/Node and Python ecosystems - you know the package management landscape, common build tooling, and where things tend to break.

• Experience with monorepo tooling (Nx or similar) and an intuition for how to make large codebases fast to work with.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Partnerships
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and creative Partnerships Product Marketing Manager to drive the success of our partner ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with our partnerships team and with leading technology companies including NVIDIA, Cloud Hyperscalers, Neocloud providers, and emerging ecosystem players, to bring differentiated joint solutions to market.

You will be responsible for shaping partner narratives, creating impactful content, and enabling joint go-to-market programs that amplify our reach. The ideal candidate combines storytelling skills, technical acumen, and the ability to collaborate across partner and internal teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Partner Storytelling & Content

- Develop compelling blog posts, white papers, solution briefs, and customer success stories highlighting the value of joint solutions.

- Translate technical integrations into clear, differentiated messaging for both technical and business audiences.

- Enablement & Training

- Build and deliver enablement programs to arm partner sales teams with the tools, messaging, and collateral they need to position and sell our solutions.

- Create sales playbooks and battlecards tailored to each partner’s ecosystem.

- Joint Go-to-Market Campaigns

- Plan and execute co-marketing campaigns with partners, including webinars, events, solution launches, and demand-generation activities.

- Manage partner marketing calendars and ensure alignment with key product milestones.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with product marketing, product management, DevRel, and growth marketing, events and sales to align messaging and GTM initiatives.

- Serve as the marketing point-of-contact for the partnerships team.

REQUIREMENTS

- 6-10 years of experience in product marketing, partner marketing, or related roles in B2B technology.

- Experience with NVIDIA technology and ecosystem or Cloud Providers technology

- Track record of working with cloud providers, ISVs, or hardware partners in joint go-to-market programs is a plus.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to create high-quality content across multiple formats.

- Strong program management skills with the ability to handle multiple partners and campaigns simultaneously.

- Technical curiosity and ability to quickly learn new technologies and ecosystems.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

NICE TO HAVE

- Familiarity with developer ecosystems, APIs, and modern software development practices.

- Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, and performance optimization concepts.

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

- Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

title: Temporary Staff Accountant (Contract / Project-Based)
description:
Category: Financial Services

Location:

Atlas Advisors LLC is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Temporary Staff Accountant to assist our CFO with a specific, project-based accounting cleanup. Our current processes involve significant manual work and complex historical details. This role is strictly project-based and will conclude once the accounting backlog is fully resolved.

This is a junior-level role best suited for someone who is eager to dig into transactional details, untangle manual data, and support fundamental accounting tasks. The ideal candidate must have a solid grasp of basic P&L and Balance Sheet principles and a strong willingness to roll up their sleeves to solve operational backlogs.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Backlog & Reconciliations

• Assist the CFO in reviewing, matching, and reconciling historical general ledger accounts, focusing on Balance Sheet and P&L line items.

• Research transactional discrepancies, missing documentation, and un-reconciled balances across manual spreadsheets and system logs.

• Perform routine subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank accounts).

• Key in, organize, and clean up historical accounting entries to bring financial records up to date.

General Accounting Operations

• Support daily transactional processing as needed to keep current operations moving while clearing the backlog.

• Enter, verify, and code vendor invoices, expense reports, and customer billing data.

• Maintain organized digital audit trails and electronic filing for all reconciled transactions.

• Gather supporting documentation for financial schedules and routine reporting as directed by the CFO.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

• Detail-Oriented & Hands-On: Absolute willingness to dive deep into granular transactional details, troubleshoot manual process errors, and work through complex spreadsheets.

• Core Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, general ledger structures, and how transactions impact the P&L and Balance Sheet.

• Software & Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, basic pivot tables, data sorting/filtering, and formula building).

• Work Ethic & Focus: Ability to follow direction closely, work independently on repetitive or detailed tasks, and ask clarifying questions when encountering anomalies.

• Role Understanding: Clear understanding that this is a temporary, contract-based position that will end when the backlog project is complete.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience.

• Software Experience: Prior experience with Deltek Costpoint is strongly preferred (experience with Unanet or other ERP systems is also a plus).

• Industry Background: Previous exposure to government contracting environments is preferred, but not required.

• Education: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or coursework toward a degree (relevant practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

​

Work Type
This is a temporary, project-based 1099 contract position. The contractor is guaranteed 20 hours per week, with the potential to scale up to 40 hours per week based on accounting backlog volume and business needs. This position is fully remote and will conclude once the accounting backlog has been resolved.
​

title: Process Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Process Engineer to join our engineering team. 

Position Description

Process Engineers at Oklo are responsible for the design, engineering analyses, systems engineering, specifications development, and operations of the fluids and power process systems used in Oklo’s power plants.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Design fluid and process systems including: piping, valves, compressors, pumps, and heat exchangers

• Define process equipment architecture, specifications, operational modes, and performance criteria

• Design, assemble, and operate prototypes to use for iterative design refinement

• Generate documentation guiding the system layout, fabrication, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of process equipment

• Serve as process system owner through multiple lifecycle stages

• Generate technical documentation to be included in regulatory filings

• Work with external vendors on process equipment analysis, procurement, and testing

• Document work using modern tools and techniques, and compose well-written, thoughtful technical reports

Minimum Qualifications:

• Engineering education, potentially Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum, or Aerospace

• Experience performing design or modification engineering on process equipment, such as that used in the petroleum, nuclear, petrochemical, or pharmaceutical industries

• Broad familiarity with engineering principles, and having strong systems engineering and operations intuition

Competencies

We are looking for a Process Engineer that is:

• Experienced in fluids/process system design, power generation, heat transfer equipment, and/or systems engineering

• Experience with compressible gas system designs including: air and inert gases

• Passionate about clean energy

• Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

• Willing and able to learn quickly

• Willing to think differently and do things in new ways

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before

• Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

• An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

• Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative : Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

title: Forward Deployed Program Manager
description:
About Flume Health

Flume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration. As a single, cloud-native integration platform, Flume’s Relay platform allows companies to easily connect various systems and vendors for efficient data exchange that’s increasingly demanded of the modern health plan. Payers, third-party administrators, prescription benefits managers, and health solutions are provided the simplicity, speed, and security they need to automate data integration and movement between relevant stakeholders. Relay supports multiple data transmission protocols, data types, and file types. By streamlining data flows between payers and solutions, a world of opportunity exists to improve access to healthcare.

Flume Health is hiring a Forward Deployed Program Manager to own program and integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. You are the person who sits at the intersection of client needs, data integration complexity, and AI-powered execution. You figure out how to get things done, unblock delivery, and drive outcomes.
What makes this role different: you will build, manage, and continuously tune a team of AI agents that solve complete problems end-to-end. Diagnosing why a connection is failing, generating client-ready deliverables, automating workflows that used to take days. You are responsible for agent performance: refining prompts, improving outputs, expanding what your agents can handle, and pushing the boundary of what one person with AI leverage can deliver.
This role requires a consulting mindset: the ability to walk into ambiguity, structure the problem, mobilize resources (human and AI), and deliver. You will manage the program and integration delivery cadence, but more importantly, you will be the person clients call when something is hard and needs to get figured out.
This is not a traditional project management role. This is an execution-oriented position with a clear progression path into Flume's Forward Deployment and Strategic Deployment practice, where you will own client engagements that drive platform transformation and measurable business outcomes for health payers and TPAs.
What You'll Do

• Client Problem-Solving:** Be the person who figures it out. When a TPA integration is failing, when a client has a data question no one can answer, when a new connection request requires scoping and creative problem-solving. You own it. Structure the problem, mobilize resources, and deliver.

• AI Agent Management & Tuning:** Build, manage, and continuously improve a team of AI agents. You own agent performance. That means refining prompts, evaluating outputs, expanding agent capabilities, and tuning workflows to solve increasingly complex problems across integration diagnostics, client deliverables, reporting automation, intake processing, and data analysis.

• Program & Integration Delivery Ownership:** Own the delivery cadence for our flagship account (80+ contracted connections) and a portfolio of secondary accounts. Manage the Jira intake workflow, ensure requirements are captured cleanly, and drive work through the build pipeline

• Client-Facing Escalation:** Serve as the primary operational POC for key client IT and Business Operations stakeholders. Attend leadership calls, surface blockers early, and ensure delivery commitments are met.

• Stakeholder Communication:** Own weekly delivery reporting to senior client stakeholders. Use AI to generate it, not your weekends

• Cross-Account Coverage:** Provide problem-solving support across the broader client portfolio as needed, including delivery troubleshooting, integration scoping, and contract coordination.

What You'll Need

• 5+ years in consulting, implementation, or healthcare operations:** You've been the person in the room who has to figure out a hard problem with incomplete information and deliver

title: Customer Success Director
description:

Adaptive6 is the leading Cloud and AI Cost Governance platform. From complex cloud architectures to modern AI workloads and AI agents, we empower engineering and FinOps teams to take full control of their enterprise spend. We don’t just report numbers - we provide actionable intelligence and continuous cost optimization that directly impacts the bottom line.
Trusted by industry giants like Ticketmaster and Bayer (who achieved a 20x ROI), our customers consistently see massive value within days.
We're hiring a Customer Success Director, based in the US, to own the post-sale relationship with our largest North American enterprise customers and to build the US side of our Customer Success practice.
You own one outcome: customers who get so much value from Adaptive6 that renewals are seamless and expansion is the natural next step.
This is a player-coach role. You'll personally own a portfolio of strategic accounts from kickoff through renewal and expansion, run the operating cadence we use to manage the book, and as we grow, hire and lead the Customer Success Managers who join you in the US.
﻿What you'll do

• Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal and expansion.

• Get customers to realized savings fast: agree on savings goals at kickoff and drive remediation with the customer's engineering teams.

• Build multi-threaded relationships from the FinOps lead and platform engineers up to the VP of Cloud Engineering, the CFO office and procurement, and run quarterly executive business reviews that tie Adaptive6 to the customer's own targets.

• Lead adoption of AI cost governance: AI and LLM spend visibility, MCP and API usage, and connecting the AI tools customers already use. This is our fastest-growing expansion motion.

• Navigate enterprise security and compliance: vendor questionnaires, SOC 2 and AI risk assessments, IAM and permission reviews. You know how to get a stalled security review moving.

• Hire, onboard and lead US-based Customer Success Managers as the book grows, and write the playbooks they run.

Requirements

• 5+ years in Customer Success or strategic account management for enterprise B2B SaaS, including 3+ years owning strategic accounts ($150K+ ACV) or leading a CS team.

• 3+ years working with Cloud Infrastructure, FinOps, DevOps, platform engineering, CSPM or observability personas. You're comfortable in a conversation about IAM roles, CloudFormation stacks, Kubernetes cost allocation, Terraform or Azure federated identity.

• Executive presence with VP and C-level sponsors, and equal comfort with the engineer who has to do the work.

• Fluent in data: you read usage and savings dashboards, build your own views, and you never bring a customer a health score you can't defend.

• Program management discipline: you run onboarding, escalations and EBRs on a cadence, with written status, owners and dates.

• Hands-on with the modern CS stack and a daily user of AI assistants and agents in your own work.

• Based in the US, with willingness to travel about 25% for on-site customer visits and industry events.

Nice to have:

• FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on FinOps experience inside an enterprise.

• Experience at a cloud cost, cloud security

title: Fundraising & Grants Member Advisors
description:
OVERVIEW
Fractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor. Fractured Atlas is a national, fully remote nonprofit arts service organization. Our work is guided by the belief that some of the boldest, most urgent creative work happens outside of institutions, led by individual artists, emerging collectives, and grassroots organizations. Our mission is to make the journey from inspiration to living practice more accessible and equitable for artists and creatives. We run the largest fiscal sponsorship program in the country, supporting thousands of active projects in every creative medium across all 50 states. Through fundraising tools, educational resources, visa letters, community programming, and 1-on-1 support, we help artists access the funding, time, and community they need to make the art the world needs.
A successful candidate in both roles will be a creative problem solver and quick learner who has an enthusiasm for the arts, is incredibly personable over the phone and email, possesses a high level of patience and understanding (particularly as it relates to explaining the same information multiple times), and is able to operate and respond in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and collected. The Grants & Member Advisor will have expertise around supporting our fiscally sponsored projects through the grant process from application through reporting. The Fundraising & Member Advisor will have expertise around advising our fiscally sponsored projects on fundraising and donation processes, including individual appeals, crowdfunding, giving day campaigns, donation policies and processes, and donation investigation.
Candidates with a work history that includes grant writing, fundraising, development, and/or customer service will likely excel. Since Fractured Atlas works virtually, these positions require strong self-motivation and both will be remotely supervised by the Associate Director of Education & Engagement.
At Fractured Atlas , we individually and collectively work hard to carry out our organization’s mission. We also understand that work is just one part of life and, through a culture of care, support team members having full and robust lives outside of work. With that foundation, our organizational culture embraces people who are open to:

• Building trust with others and addressing equitable distribution of responsibilities when collaborating.

• Learning new ways of working while welcoming change as a way to reshape processes/policies/programming that no longer serve our values.

• Transparency in communications, decision making, and feedback.

• Centering care and connection in our individual work and in relation to our colleagues.

We recognize that the culture and core values of an organization should continue to evolve to reflect the world we live in. At any given time, we recognize that there might be emerging values other than ourstated values and we continue to have conversations about stated and emerging values.
Additionally, at Fractured Atlas we work to adhere toanti-racism and anti-oppression principlesin all areas of our internal and external work. This commitment is grounded in our belief that change is possible, and that our work and that of the artistic community as a whole will grow stronger as oppression is eliminated.
In our current phase of this journey towards being an Anti-Racist Anti-Oppressive organization, the whole staff is engaged in all staff ARAO meetings led by rotating teams and undergo training as part of their onboarding process. We recognize that we do not have all of the answers as we pursue this work. This work will continue to shift as the Fractured Atlas team changes. We ask that new team members join us as we continue to learn, practice, and grow in this work. Learn more about what it’s like to work at Fractured Atlas here.

A GLIMPSE OF YOUR WORK

Our Firm
Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a first-class Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.

This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.
What You’ll Do

•
The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. •
The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.

The documents. Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you .

•
Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.

•
How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.

• Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively

• Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration

• Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system - or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

title: Security Engineer, Kubernetes
locationText: Palo Alto, CA; Austin, TX; New York, NY; Washington, DC
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We protect the platform that runs X and SpaceXSI. We don’t just report issues, we actively look for real risks and exploits in our Kubernetes environments and turn them into durable fixes and tooling. You will secure the platform behind X and SpaceXSI’s infrastructure, products, and workloads. If you know pod and platform security, think in attack paths, and want to build the defenses that make the platform safer at scale, we want to hear from you.

We Value

• Understanding how Kubernetes can actually be abused, not only how it is configured

• Shipping practical controls and tooling over writing policy documents

• Least privilege and defense-in-depth at fleet scale

• Clear findings and fixes that platform teams can act on

• Safe, constrained validation that does not put production at risk

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Secure the platform end to end: nodes, clusters, pods, roles, tokens, secrets, service-to-service communication, and the supply chain

• Find and remediate overprivileged permissions, dangerous pod and workload settings, and escalation paths in operators, admission, networking, identity, and monitoring

• Assess our own platform the way an adversary would, including container and pod breakout, privilege escalation, and movement across workloads, using safe and constrained validation, then fix what you find

• Design and build security tooling and automation, including AI-assisted analysis, that catches risky configuration and overprivilege before or after it ships

• Strengthen identity and secrets handling so workloads receive only the access they need

• Improve supply-chain security through secure base images, continuous scanning, and related controls

• Review changes that affect RBAC, operators, ServiceAccounts, network policies, and anything running with elevated privileges

• Partner with platform and product teams as a security owner, taking problems from identification through rollout

• Contribute to fleet-wide hardening, policy enforcement, and safer defaults

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years in platform security, Kubernetes security, or offensive security against production infrastructure

• Deep knowledge of pod and workload security: privileged containers, capabilities, host namespaces, host path mounts, service accounts, RBAC, admission control, and network isolation

• Working knowledge of identity, secrets, workload identity, service-to-service trust, supply chain, runtime, and cloud access

• Able to think like an attacker, measure blast radius, and turn the path into a detection, control, or tool

• Comfortable with operators, custom resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows

• Able to build or modify security tooling in Go, Python, or Rust when a control needs automation

• Bonus: Image scanning, SBOMs, secure base images, policy-as-code (Kyverno, OPA), multi-cluster environments, runtime detection, and security testing of customer-facing application

• Open to working out of one of our offices: Palo Alto, Austin, DC, or New York. 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience developing AI-driven security tools or integrating AI into security workflows

• Familiarity with Kubernet

The successful candidate will connect business context with technical execution. They will clarify ambiguous requests, define value and priority, align stakeholders on scope and acceptance criteria, and communicate effectively with executives, business partners, data analysts, analytics engineers, and data engineers.

• Engage business partners to understand the business objective, decisions to be supported, target audience, measures of success, constraints, and urgency behind each request.

• Translate business questions into well-defined epics, features, user stories, data requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and nonfunctional requirements that the Impact Intelligence team can execute.

Our CrowdStrike Services team offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of engagements including front page incident response investigations for organisations you’ll find on the annual Fortune 100 list.

• Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

• Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

title: Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 As a software engineer on Benchling's Infrastructure team, you will design, build, and operate the platforms, services, and tooling that let every Benchling engineering team ship and run software reliably, securely, and cost-effectively. Our work spans the foundations of our AWS environment: compute (Kubernetes/EKS), networking, secrets and identity, observability, infrastructure-as-code, and the economics of running all of it at scale.

We hire software engineers for this team because strong programming, systems design, and problem-solving skills are the most durable foundation for infrastructure impact. You will independently scope and own meaningful, multi-quarter pieces of our platform end to end, from an ambiguous starting point to a production rollout and operational handoff, building paved roads that make the secure, reliable, and efficient path the default for engineers across Benchling.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own projects end-to-end, from initial design and tech plan, to prototype, to production rollout and operational handoff.

- Design, build, and maintain internal applications, APIs, automation, and tooling (CLIs, Slack apps, serverless services, and AI-powered assistants) that support Benchling's cloud platform and infrastructure workflows.

- Own parts of our AWS foundation, including Kubernetes (EKS), networking, secrets and PKI, and the security and observability capabilities around them, with clear SLOs, runbooks, and actionable telemetry.

- Advance our infrastructure-as-code practices at scale: operate and improve our Terraform Cloud release system, reusable Terraform modules, and the tooling around them, with policy-as-code guardrails that let service teams self-serve safely.

- Drive cloud cost governance as an engineering discipline: build cost visibility and anomaly alerting, allocate shared platform costs to the services that drive them, analyze usage trends.

title: Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety
description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.
Solutions and Tool Specialist - Functional Safety
About the Role
Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market ADI serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio.
This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure - starting with Medini Analyze component libraries - support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed.
This role offers a structured path into functional safety - with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across ADI. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution.
Why This Team
The FSO operates as ADI's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact - the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product ADI ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer.
Job Responsibilities:
Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across ADI product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance.
Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments.
Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing.
Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities.
Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops.
Who You Will Work With:
Day-to-day: You will work alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists around the world, who provide technical direction and mentoring on safety analysis and Medini.
Across the FSO: You will collaborate with Functional Safety Managers and Safety Specialists globally to understand where enablement assets have the highest impact.
Engineering teams: You will work with Design Engineers across business units who are the consumers of the tools, templates, and training content you help build.
Tool vendors: You will participate in vendor engagements with Synops

- Startup Growth: Adaptable to startup pace and change.

At Mitratech , we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.
For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.
As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!
Job Overview
ARIES is moving from launch to real customer adoption. The Legal Deployment Strategist owns the technical activation of ARIES across assigned customer accounts-turning the platform on and driving initial use cases into live, verified, daily operation.
This role operates in tight coordination with the Value Experience (VX) team and Value Adoption Consultants (VAC), who lead account enablement, change management, process improvement, and broader training. Rather than running separate workstreams, the Deployment Strategist and the VX/VAC teams function as a unified front to ensure seamless technical onboarding and long-term customer value.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Technical Activation Ownership: Direct the end-to-end technical activation of assigned ARIES accounts from initial kickoff through steady-state adoption, partnering closely with VX/VAC owners on existing accounts and Services/Implementation Partners on net-new implementations.

• Account Readiness Alignment: For existing TeamConnect accounts, partner jointly with the Account Manager and VX/VAC to evaluate process fit, data foundations, and user proficiency prior to enablement, ensuring activation sits on a stable foundation.

• Coordinated Net-New Onboarding: Partner from day one with Services, Implementation Partners, and VACs so that ARIES activation occurs in lockstep with core system rollouts rather than as an isolated add-on.

• Workflow Translation: Analyze customer-specific legal department operations and translate them into tailored ARIES use cases, building upon existing account intelligence rather than re-discovering baseline workflows.

• Configuration & Launch: Work hands-on with customers (remotely and on site) to deploy and validate an initial starter set of 10 to 15 standard use cases.

• Security & Access Validation: Collaborate with Engineering and Information Security teams to ensure user access controls and permissions contain zero gaps.

• Adoption Monitoring & Risk Mitigation: Monitor platform telemetry to evaluate utilization patterns. Identify low-adoption or at-risk accounts early and collaborate with VX/VAC and Services on a unified mitigation plan before escalating to Sales or Customer Success.

• Standardized Escalation: Direct custom workflow requests outside the starter scope through standard ARIES support models rather than running ad-hoc, parallel tracks.

• Feedback Loop: Partner with Product and AI Engineering to feed field learnings back into core product roadmaps, identifying high-impact use cases that can transition into standard platform skills.

• Enablement Collaboration: Assist VX/VAC in translating emerging platform capabilities into training materials, e-learning courses, and interactive office hours.

title: Software Engineer II, Cloud (Dublin, Hybrid)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
We are building the next generation of our UI foundation for CrowdStrike's platform called Kestrel which includes new UI and backend features to help customers 'Stop the Breach' by unifying data across security domains, streamlining access to the most important security information, and allowing users to more effectively personalize their user experience by role. You will play a key role in innovating, building and maintaining critical backend features in support of the Kestrel platform.

Bring your experience in distributed technologies, your great API and systems design sensibilities, and your passion for writing code that performs at high scale. Your work will enable hundreds of our UI engineers spread across dozens of feature teams to build the experience customers need to keep pace with and respond to adversaries by leveraging the power of the CrowdStrike platform in the most effective manner for their respective teams. You will be working with multiple backend teams, core service teams, and UI + backend feature teams to bring this new feature to life.

If this sounds like the challenge for you and you have the experience + technical skills that reflect your readiness, submit your resume and let's have a conversation.

PLEASE NOTE: This role is open to candidates based within 30 miles of Dublin, only.

While the position is fully remote for now, CrowdStrike plans to open a Dublin office (within the next 18-24 months). Once the office is established, we anticipate a hybrid working arrangement of approximately 2 -3 days per week in office .
What You’ll Do:

• Design, develop, document, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large scale services.

• Take ownership and be accountable for deliverables.

• Triage system issues and debug by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on service operations.

• Mentor other engineers on web and backend engineers on use of our feature services.

• Constantly re-evaluate our products to improve architecture, testing coverage, knowledge models, user experience, performance, observability and stability.

• Partner with product teams in understanding their needs, work with PM to document the new requirements, and implement those new features within our feature services

• Participate in on-call responsibilities for the sustainment and maximizing the availability of the service

What You’ll Use:

• Go (Golang)

• Python

• GIT

• Cassandra

• Kafka

• OpenSearch

• Kubernetes

• Postgres

• Redis

• AWS Cloud

What You’ll Need:

• Degree in Computer Science (or commensurate experience in data structures/algorithms/distributed systems).

• The ability to scale backend systems - sharding, partitioning, scaling

description:
Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

Material Bank is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager to support a broad portfolio of Brand Partners and help them maximize the value of their partnership. Working alongside a dedicated coordinator, you will serve as the primary relationship owner, delivering a responsive, consistent, and valuable experience across your portfolio.

This is a fast paced, highly client-facing role for someone who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and managing a significant portfolio with confidence and efficiency. You will balance responsive account management with proactive engagement, helping Brand Partners navigate Material Bank, understand their performance, and identify opportunities to strengthen their presence and results. The right candidate is analytical, decisive, solutions oriented, and highly tech savvy, with a natural ability to leverage technology, automation, and AI to streamline workflows, scale engagement, and maximize productivity. Success in this role requires someone who can work smarter, move quickly, and deliver meaningful results across a high volume of accounts.

We’d love for you to be based in one of our major markets (South Florida, New York, Boston or Chicago), working in a hybrid capacity two to three days a week. For the right person, we’re open to Remote with approximately 2-3 trips a year to connect with the team and our Brand Partners.

What you’ll do

• Brand Partner Success: Take ownership of the overall success and retention of your Brand Partners, ensuring they understand the value of their partnership and have the resources and support needed to succeed on Material Bank.

• Portfolio Management: Effectively manage a broad and diverse portfolio of 150+ Brand Partners by leveraging data, technology, AI, and automation to streamline workflows, prioritize opportunities, and deliver consistent, high quality engagement at scale. Continuously identify ways to improve efficiency and maximize impact across your portfolio.

• Performance & Insights: Use Brand Partner performance data, health scores, engagement, and other account insights to identify trends, opportunities, and areas where additional support can improve results.

• Proactive Engagement: Maintain consistent engagement across your portfolio through relevant communications, performance insights, educational content, and targeted outreach based on Brand Partner needs.

• Retention: Proactively identify Brand Partners that may need additional support, understand their challenges, and work with them to reinforce value and strengthen the partnership.

• Brand Enablement: Help Brand Partners get more from Material Bank through webinars, group trainings, office hours, educational content, and other programs designed to increase knowledge, adoption, and engagement.

title: Co-op, Software, Applied AI Platform Engineer
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. The Platform Engineering team owns the core infrastructure and developer-facing services that power Lila's AI Science Factory™ - including APIs, data pipelines, and the agentic systems that orchestrate scientific workflows at scale.

This co-op has two focus tracks. Candidates may be matched to one or both based on interest and fit:

Track 1 - Data Platform: Build pipelines and services that structure scientific knowledge (literature, patents, lab data) into signals that power Lila's AI models and applications.

Track 2 - Agentic SSR (AI and Server-Side Rendering): Build the server-rendered, agentic layer of the Lila Platform - the infrastructure that enables AI agents to compose and serve dynamic scientific interfaces at runtime.

In either track, you will ship production code, work alongside research scientists and ML engineers, and contribute to a platform that runs real scientific experiments.

What You'll Be Building

Data Platform Track

• Build and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines for scientific literature, patents, and lab-generated data

• Implement structured data extraction workflows, including schema design, validation, and quality evaluation

• Integrate retrieval and RAG pipelines that surface relevant documents, tables, and figures to downstream Lila applications

• Generate and validate structured datasets; run end-to-end pipelines and analyze results against clear evaluation criteria

• Collaborate with research scientists to translate scientific domain requirements into robust data models

• Document findings and present results to the team; contribute to a publication or open-source project where the work supports it

Agentic SSR Track

• Build server-side rendering services and APIs that enable AI agents to compose and deliver dynamic scientific interfaces

• Implement agentic workflow primitives: task routing, context management, streaming responses, and tool integration

• Develop platform features end-to-end: schema design, business logic, API surface, and automated tests

• Instrument code for observability; participate in debugging and root-cause analysis of production issues

• Improve developer experience through internal tooling, reusable libraries, and documentation

• Contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

• Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and system design

• Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript

• Experience building or consuming REST or GraphQL APIs

• Familiarity with relational databases and SQL

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and communicate progress clearly

• Curiosity about scientific data or AI-driven software systems and a willingness to learn quickly

Bonus Points For

Data Platform Track

• Familiarity with NLP, document understanding (OCR, table/figure extraction), or multimodal models

• Experience with LLM applications, embeddings, or retrieval systems (chunking, reranking, vector search)

• Experience building evaluation sets, annotation workflows, or working with messy real-world data

• Interest in scientific document parsing or knowledge graph construction

Agentic SSR Track

• Experience with server-side rendering frameworks (Next.js, Remix, or similar)

• Exposure to LLM APIs, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar), or AI-assisted developer tooling

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures or message queues (Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS)

Both Tracks

• Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source projects

• Prior internship or co-op experience in a software engineering role

title: Human Resource Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

Hybrid-San Carlos or Pleasanton Office

The HR Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day HR operations, with primary responsibility for onboarding and offboarding temporary employees. Reporting to the Manager, HR Operations, this role processes personnel transactions, responds to employee inquiries, and coordinates with internal partners.

The Coordinator also supports the HR Operations Analyst with HRIS administration, reporting, system testing, process improvements, and special projects.

Primary Responsibilities

Temporary Employee Onboarding & Offboarding

• Coordinate onboarding for temporary employees, including required documentation, system setup, and new hire orientation.

• Partner with staffing agencies, IT, and other stakeholders to complete onboarding requirements and meet start dates.

• Coordinate offboarding at the end of temporary assignments, including personnel transactions, notifications, and documentation.

• Support completion of Form I-9 and employment eligibility verification requirements.

• Collect and track required education and certification documentation from new and current temporary employees.

• Assist with consultant onboarding and offboarding as assigned.

Personnel Records & HRIS Administration

• Maintain accurate and complete personnel records in Workday, Allworks, and other applicable systems, following record retention requirements.

• Process approved changes to compensation, department, manager, work location, shift, and other employment information.

• Create and update job codes and related system records according to established procedures and approvals.

• Support bulk data changes through Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) uploads, including preparing files, validating data, reviewing results, and retaining supporting documentation.

HRIS & Process Support

• Assist the HR Operations Analyst with testing and implementing HRIS updates, workflows, and new processes.

• Troubleshoot routine system issues, document findings and resolutions, and escalate issues as needed.

• Develop process documentation and job aids, and assist with training HR Coordinators on system transactions and updated processes.

• Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and the employee experience.

• Support new operational initiatives, including international employee onboarding processes, as assigned.

Reporting & Data Quality

• Run, validate, and distribute recurring and ad hoc HRIS reports.

• Perform monthly data audits, investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate corrections through resolution.

• Collect and summarize data to support HR programs, compliance activities, and operational decisions.

Employee Support & Communications

• Respond to temporary employee and stakeholder inquiries through the HR ticketing system and other channels, documenting actions and escalating issues as needed.

• Prepare and distribute approved communications, including compensation and assignment-end letters.

• Respond to employment verification requests.

HR Programs & Special Projects

• Assist the HR Operations Analyst with implementing and administering HR programs.

title: Strategic Finance Analyst
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

- A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

- PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

- Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog.

 

THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

- Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

- Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams - autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

- Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication - PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

- Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.

JOB SUMMARY

Help us understand how PostHog grows, what that growth costs, and what we should plan for next. Working directly with our Finance team, you’ll own the day-to-day consolidated financial model, expense planning, and board reporting, with their guidance. You’ll explain differences between actual results and plans, partner with team leads on hiring and spending decisions, and ask thoughtful questions that challenge our assumptions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Corporate planning and consolidation

- Maintain the integrated three-statement forecast: income statement, balance sheet, and cash

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

title: R&D Test Engineering Intern (SoFuel)
description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com .

Tempo is seeking a motivated, hands-on Engineering Intern to support the development and experimental validation of its high-temperature thermal energy storage technology.

The intern will work primarily on the SoFuel test stand , an experimental system designed to investigate high-temperature solid pellet storage, gas-solid heat transfer, granular material flow, and thermal system performance. This position offers an opportunity to work directly with experimental hardware, operate and improve a research-scale test system, analyze test data, and contribute to the development of next-generation energy storage technology.

We are looking for someone who enjoys building, testing, troubleshooting, and solving practical engineering problems in a laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experimental Testing and Test Stand Operation

• Assist in preparing, setting up, and operating the SoFuel experimental test stand under the supervision of experienced engineers.

• Execute experimental test plans to evaluate gas-solid heat transfer, particle flow behavior, and system performance.

• Monitor operating parameters, including temperature, gas flow rate, pressure, and particle movement.

• Conduct repeatability tests and evaluate the effects of changing operating conditions.

• Follow established operating procedures and safety protocols during testing.

2. Instrumentation and Data Acquisition

• Set up, calibrate, and troubleshoot sensors and measurement equipment, including thermocouples, flow meters, pressure transducers, and distance sensors.

• Monitor and record experimental data using the test stand's data acquisition and control systems.

• Verify data quality, identify measurement anomalies, and maintain organized experimental records.

• Support improvements to instrumentation and data collection procedures.

3. Troubleshooting and Test Stand Improvements

• Assist in identifying and resolving operational issues such as particle clogging, inconsistent flow, temperature fluctuations, and sensor malfunctions.

• Support mechanical modifications, component replacement, and routine maintenance of the test stand.

• Work with engineers to evaluate improvements to gas flow control, particle discharge mechanisms, and test stand reliability.

• Help implement and validate improvements to operating procedures and control sequences.

4. Data Analysis and Reporting

• Process and analyze experimental data using Excel, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

• Generate plots showing temperature profiles, flow behavior, pressure changes, and system performance.

• Compare experimental results across different operating conditions.

• Prepare concise technical summaries, test reports, and presentations documenting results and observations.

• Maintain accurate test logs and document experimental findings and recommended improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a BS or MS degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline.

• Strong interest in hands-on experimental engineering and laboratory testing.

• Basic understanding of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics.

• Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation and data acquisitio
